_note: au by KDDI / Sony Ericsson W42S (MSM6550, BREW 3.1.2.42). Screen 240x320 is what the firmware itself names: W42S_NOR.bin carries 'QVGA(240x320)' and the WAP profile 'x-up-devcap-screenpixels: 240,268' (268 + status bar + soft keys = 320). An older handoff says 240x400; no firmware string supports it, and the two sizes measure identically on the packs tried, so the firmware's own number is used. The carrier's private classes still need --carrier kddi on the command line: a device file describes the handset, not the operator.
